messages:
morgan: Just opened a small PR to unify our function-invoke + structured-output examples across SDKs. Mainly link fixes and one JSON example change. PTAL when you have a sec. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
tara: Thanks — can you paste the PR diff for the JSON schema change? I'm worried about the nullable fields we previously discussed. Also can we add a short migration note for v2 consumers?@morgan
morgan: Diff snippet: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "result": { "type": ["object", "null"] },
    "meta": { "type": "object" }
  },
  "required": ["meta"]
}
```
I made `result` nullable to reflect tool callers that may return no output. Migration note draft in the PR description.
ben: CI doc-tests failing on the new SDK snippet for Python — error is an import path mismatch. Putting logs here: ```
E ImportError: cannot import name 'invoke_function' from 'redwood_sdk' (/workspace/sdk.py)
```
Possibly we renamed the function in the latest alpha.
anika: Small wording suggestion for guardrails section: change "strict schema enforcement" to "schema validation with graceful fallback" so we don't scare customers. Also add a brief example of a parse fallback that returns a minimal envelope.
morgan: Good catch ben — I'll update the Python snippet to `from redwood import invoke` and adjust call example. Also will update guardrail phrasing per anika.
docs-bot: Heads-up: live docs site build queued for deploy after merge. If the PR lands before 18:00 UTC it will go out in the next window.
tara: For the migration note, can you add a tiny code sample showing how to handle nullable `result` in JS (both inline and SDK-based handlers)? Keeps churn low for app teams.
morgan: Added two JS examples in the PR: inline check + helper using `sdk.parseOrFallback(response, schema)` (pseudocode). Also fixed a broken internal link to /guides/tool-invoke/compat.
ben: Re-ran doc-tests locally with updated import — passes now. :thumbsup:
anika: Also flagging that the docs reference an internal lint rule `docs-parse` in one place — replace with the public `parse-helpers` link.
morgan: Done — swapped link and left a short note in the PR description about why we chose the fallback pattern.
ci-bot: PR #842 status: all checks passed, reviewers: tara, ben. Ready for merge.
tara: I'll do a quick read and merge after lunch. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
morgan: Thanks all — follow-up: I'll open a tiny follow-on PR to add a couple of unit tests for the JS snippets so we don't regress.
